nodes.title: REQ · App game screen mounts PhaserHost with BootScene instead of the flat image
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/App.tsx renders <SceneView .../> (flat image plus hotspot buttons) in the GameLayout scene prop. Desired behavior: render <PhaserHost scenes={[BootScene]} /> in a full-size container in that slot, keeping ActionMenu, the Suggest button and ContributionSheet. Expected result: one canvas host is created when the playing view mounts and destroyed on unmount. Why: Phaser must own scene rendering.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given Begin is clicked, when App renders, then the element with data-testid phaser-host exists and no img named after the scene title exists.
- Given Begin is clicked, when App renders, then createGame is called once with a scenes array containing BootScene.
- Given the playing view is unmounted, when cleanup runs, then the mocked game's destroy is called once with true.


## Scope
- In scope: App.tsx scene slot composition
- Out of scope: PhaserHost internals
- Out of scope: BootScene internals
- Preserve: ActionMenu, Suggest What Happens Next button and ContributionSheet rendering


## Technical constraints
- PhaserHost is mounted only after Begin so the intro screen creates no game


## Definition of done
- SceneView is no longer rendered by App
- PhaserHost receives BootScene

nodes.title: REQ · Canvas objectClick events select the object and open the ActionMenu
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene emits phaserToReact 'objectClick' {id}, but nothing in src consumes it; selection currently comes only from SceneView buttons calling setSelectedId. Desired behavior: App subscribes to phaserToReact.on('objectClick') and calls setSelectedId(id), unsubscribing on unmount. Expected result: a canvas click opens the ActionMenu for that object. Why: interactions must keep updating real game state after the HTML hotspots are gone.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the App is mounted, when phaserToReact emits objectClick with id bookshelf, then the ActionMenu shows the bookshelf actions.
- Given the App is unmounted, when objectClick is emitted afterwards, then no handler runs and no React state update warning occurs.
- Given the ActionMenu is open, when an action is chosen, then game state updates through useGame.act as before.


## Scope
- In scope: objectClick subscription in App.tsx
- Out of scope: Hover, characterClick and highlightObject handling
- Preserve: useGame.act and choose behavior
- Preserve: event bus API in phaser/events.ts


## Technical constraints
- Use the existing phaserToReact bus and its on() unsubscribe function


## Definition of done
- Subscription added before the early return so hook order is stable
- Unsubscribes on unmount


## Non-functional requirements
- No leaked listeners after unmount


## Clarifying questions
- None
